newsitem.title: USA: Virtual Gaming wins operating license.
newsitem.headline: Virtual Gaming wins operating license.

text.p: Virtual Gaming Technologies Inc on Monday said it received a license to operate its Internet Casino and Sports Book from the government of Antigua.
In a statement it said the license allows it to conduct gaming on the Internet from Antigua for five years.
Virtual Gaming has set up offices in St. John's, Antigua, and is currently installing computer servers to launching its service in July, the company said.
